# BITS College

> BITS College (School of Systems and Technology) — private higher learning institution in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia offering Software Engineering and IT Management programs.

- [Home](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/): Main landing page
- [Who We Are](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/who-we-are): Mission, vision, accreditation
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/undergraduate-program): Software Engineering
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/graduate-program): IT Management
- [Admissions](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/undergrad-admission): Undergraduate admission
- [News & Events](https://www.bitscollege.edu.et/college-news): College news and events
- [Apply](https://applications.bitscollege.edu.et): Applications portal
